zh: 品牌标志改为卡片与管理窗口，开关下方每套标志一张卡片，点卡片切换，指针所在的图形或字标上出现画笔进入编辑，「管理」在开关左侧，新建、改名、浅色与深色图片、复制与删除都在管理窗口里完成，编辑预设时卡片顺序保持不变
en: Brand marks become cards with a manager, one card per set under the switch that a click picks, a pencil on the mark or word under the pointer opening its editor, Manage beside the switch, and creating, naming, light and dark images, copying and deleting all done in the manager, with the cards keeping their order while a preset is edited
